content_sections.heading: East Godavari ASHA Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The tables on pages 1 and 2 of the notification provide the PHC, UPHC, village and ward-wise vacancy distribution. There are 44 vacancies across 43 notified locations, with two vacancies shown for Vadisaleru-1 under Rangampeta.

content_sections.heading: Educational Qualification
content_sections.text: The applicant must be a literate woman who has completed at least Class 10. The educational qualification may be relaxed if no suitable woman possessing the prescribed qualification is available in the concerned area.

content_sections.heading: Eligibility for Rural Areas
content_sections.text: The applicant must be a woman resident of the concerned village. Preference will be given to married, widowed, divorced or separated women. The preferred age group is 25 to 45 years. The candidate should have effective communication and leadership skills. She should be able to connect with and support the local community. She should have family and social support to perform ASHA duties. The minimum educational qualification is Class 10.

content_sections.heading: Eligibility for Urban Areas
content_sections.text: The applicant must be a woman resident of the identified slum or vulnerable cluster. She should preferably belong to the vulnerable group for which the ASHA is being selected. Preference will be given to married, widowed, divorced or separated women. The preferred age group is 25 to 45 years. The candidate should have communication and leadership skills. She should be fluent in the local language of the population she will serve. The minimum educational qualification is Class 10.

content_sections.heading: Age Limit
content_sections.text: Candidates should preferably be between 25 and 45 years of age. The notification allows relaxation of the age and educational criteria if a suitable woman meeting the prescribed conditions is unavailable in the concerned area.

content_sections.heading: Salary
content_sections.text: The notification does not specify the salary or honorarium payable to the selected ASHA workers.

content_sections.heading: Application Fee
content_sections.text: No application fee is mentioned in the notification.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: The selection process will include the following stages: Scrutiny of applications and supporting documents Preparation of the provisional merit list Receipt and consideration of objections Publication of the final merit list Final selection and issue of permission to the concerned Medical Officers The VHNC or VHSNC resolution and approval for the applicant’s area must be enclosed with the application.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for East Godavari ASHA Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Obtain or download the prescribed ASHA application form. Enter the candidate’s name, husband’s name, date of birth and social category. Provide the full communication address and village or ward details. Mention the PHC or UPHC in which the application is being submitted. Enter the Aadhaar number, mobile number and email address. Attach the required certificates and VHNC/VHSNC resolution. Sign the declaration in the application form. Get the application forwarded by the Chairman of VHNSC/UHNSC, where applicable. Submit the completed application to the concerned PHC or UPHC. Ensure that the application is submitted by 25 September 2026.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Class 10 or SSC certificate as proof of date of birth and qualification Residence certificate or ration card Resolution and approval of the VHNC/VHSNC of the respective area Latest caste certificate issued by the concerned Mandal Revenue Officer, if applicable Aadhaar card Latest disability certificate issued by the Medical Board through SADAREM, if applying under the PH quota Other supporting documents required in the application form

content_sections.heading: Application Submission Address
content_sections.text: The completed application and documents must be handed over to the concerned PHC or UPHC for the notified village, ward or urban area. The application form on page 4 is addressed to: The District Medical and Health Officer East Godavari District Rajamahendravaram, Andhra Pradesh

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Only women candidates are eligible. The candidate must be a resident of the respective notified village, ward, slum or vulnerable cluster. Applications must be submitted to the concerned PHC or UPHC. The last date for receipt of applications is 25 September 2026. Candidates should attach all required certificates and the local committee resolution. Applicants without the required caste certificate will be treated as Open Category candidates. The number of vacancies may increase, decrease or be cancelled based on the District Selection Committee’s decision. Candidates should provide correct information in the application form. Providing incorrect information may result in cancellation or termination.
